title: 1415. The k-th Lexicographical String of All Happy Strings of Length n

examples.explanation: The list ["a", "b", "c"] contains all happy strings of length 1. The third string is "c".
There are only 3 happy strings of length 1.
There are 12 different happy string of length 3 ["aba", "abc", "aca", "acb", "bab", "bac", "bca", "bcb", "cab", "cac", "cba", "cbc"]. You will find the 9th string = "cab"
